transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Card Member Services. My name is Marcus. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Marcus, my name is Wendell Ashby. I was looking over my finances and noticed a weird charge on my account, like a billing mistake or something.
Agent: I can certainly take a look into that for you, Mr. Ashby. Before we get into the details, could you please confirm your home address and the last four digits of your card?
Customer: Sure, it's 57 Corliss Avenue, and the card ends in 8831.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Ashby, that matches our records. Could you tell me the date and the dollar figure of the charge you're asking about?
Customer: Yes, it was on September 14th from Coastline Car Rental. It was for $412.30, and it showed up on my September 24th statement.
Agent: Got it, Coastline Car Rental on September 14th for $412.30. Could you explain what happened with this transaction?
Customer: Well, that's the thing. I didn't rent any car. The receipt info online says it was in Oregon, and I've literally never set foot in that state in my entire life.
Agent: Understood. Did anyone else have permission to use your card, such as a family member or coworker?
Customer: No, nobody. I live by myself, and nobody touches my wallet or has my card number.
Agent: And did you have the physical card with you the entire time around September 14th?
Customer: Yes, it never left my wallet. That's why I think someone somewhere made a billing mistake with the numbers when typing them in.
Agent: Have you tried reaching out to Coastline Car Rental about this charge?
Customer: I tried calling their main phone number once, but it just rang and rang before sending me to voicemail, so I didn't get any answers from them.
Agent: Alright, let me make sure I have all these details down accurately. You're calling about a charge for $412.30 from Coastline Car Rental dated September 14, 2026, which appeared on your September 24, 2026 statement, and you have never traveled to Oregon, rented a vehicle from them, or permitted anyone else to use your card.
Customer: That's it exactly.
